name: Delta Tracking with DDA Iteration (Macrocell-based)
definition: A ray-marching technique for volume rendering that combines a Discrete Differential Analyzer (DDA) for traversing a coarse spatial partition (macrocells) with Delta Tracking (Russian Roulette) for sampling absorption and scattering events within those cells. It handles sparse or heterogeneous media by skipping empty macrocells and using a majorant density.
summary: This technique combines DDA macrocell traversal with probabilistic Delta Tracking to efficiently skip empty regions and non-interacting areas within cells, avoiding the overhead of full per-voxel traversal.
